name: fantasy
description: companion de fantasy marca: contabilidad de rivales, seguimiento de cláusulas e inteligencia de mercado
author: Juan Mier

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fantasy/web build && pnpm run copy-static && pnpm --filter @fantasy/api build
scripts.copy-static: rm -rf packages/api/static && mkdir -p packages/api/static && cp -r packages/web/build/. packages/api/static/
